name: logs
description: Agent-friendly log + telemetry sink. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (logs-serve) + generated SDK. The client selects its transport from the environment: HASNA_LOGS_API_URL + HASNA_LOGS_API_KEY select the hosted HTTP /v1 API (API-key auth via @hasna/contracts); otherwise logs use SQLite at ~/.hasna/logs/logs.db. The serve selects its backend from the environment: HASNA_LOGS_DATABASE_URL selects PostgreSQL (the shared S3-backed log sink other apps route to); otherwise it serves the local SQLite database.
